_notes: Transcribed from Gear card scans AJ0156-AJ0278 (Cycle I). Duplicates collapsed: 'codes' lists every physical copy.

Offensive stats (left side, rulebook p.46): atk = Attack dice (diamond), prec = Precision bonus (+N), power = Weapon Power dice per hit (r=red, b=black, w=white tiers), bonusPower = Bonus Power added once per Attack if >=1 hit ('+1' = raw Power, 'r'/'b' = extra die).

Defensive stats (right side): armor = Armor dice (red die icons), evasion = Evasion bonus (+N with evasion icon), evasionReroll = Evasion re-roll count (circled icon with number) - the reroll vs bonus reading of that icon is TBC.
slot: hand1 (one-hand weapon), hand2 (two-hand weapon), ranged (bow icon; occupies hands - 1 vs 2 TBC), armor, support, attachment.
Cost icons in text: Ψ = gain +1 Fate, ⟳ = exhaust this card, X = discard this card, [R] = reaction-type action (diamond-! icon; mapping TBC vs rulebook p.54/60), [charge] = discard a charge.
danger: effects gated by current Danger threshold (red 'A/N+' banner).

keywords.Ascended: Ignores Power Level penalties (irrelevant in Cycle I).
keywords.Attack Re-roll X: During an Attack Roll, re-roll up to X Attack dice at no cost.
keywords.Auto-break X: During the first ability window, place X Break tokens in the Kratos Pool.
keywords.Block X: While performing an Evasion Roll, treat X successful hits as evaded.
keywords.Bypass: You may move through other Titans; cannot end voluntary movement on one.
keywords.Carving X: When you wound the Primordial, test Wisdom (8+). On success gain X additional non-Core Primordial resources from that BP card.
keywords.Commit: To attack with this weapon, gain +1 Fate.
keywords.Cumbersome: During the second ability window, if you successfully wounded with this weapon, exhaust it (voluntary exhaust).
keywords.Deadly: During an Attack Roll, replace one regular Attack die with an additional Crit die. If you roll only one Attack die, gain a Crit Chance on natural 9-10 instead.
keywords.Diversion: During the second ability window, place a Diversion token in the Kratos Pool. An attacking Titan may use one to ignore Fail Responses until the end of their Attack.
keywords.Dodge: When you are about to perform an Evasion Roll, gain +1 Evasion bonus for this roll.
keywords.Hide: If not in front of the Primordial, at end of turn become Hidden (+1 Evasion, +1 Precision; pass PT token to highest-Rage other Titan). Ends if you move in front, gain PT, after second ability window of your Attack, or end of next turn.
keywords.Lifeline: When about to die from a Chasm, displace instead; when about to die from a Boundless edge, stop adjacent to it.
keywords.Opening X: Second ability window: place X Opening tokens. Each Opening token adds +1 to each Attack die result.
keywords.Break X: Second ability window: place X Break tokens. Each Break token turns 1 Potential symbol into 1 Power.
keywords.Power Re-roll X: During the Power Roll, re-roll up to X Power dice.
keywords.Provoke: First ability window: gain the Priority Target token and turn the Primordial to face you.
keywords.Pull X: Pull the target X spaces towards you along the shortest path.
keywords.Pushback X: Push the target in front of you X spaces, moving along with it (first or second ability window).
keywords.Ranged X-Y: Must be at least X and at most Y spaces from target. Not stackable.
keywords.Reach X: May attack from up to X spaces away. Not stackable.
keywords.Reflex: Move up to 1 space. Advanced Reflex: up to 2. Superior Reflex: up to 3.
keywords.Reinforce X: When about to resolve an Armor Roll, add X red dice to the Armor pool. Advanced = black, Superior = white.
keywords.Reposition X: Second ability window: move up to X spaces.
keywords.Rocksteady: When about to suffer Knockdown, ignore it.
keywords.Sacrifice: First ability window: you may gain +1 Danger to place 1 Break token in the Kratos Pool.
keywords.Second Chance: After drawing a Trauma or Obol card, ignore and discard it, draw another from the same deck (cannot ignore the second). Usable while knocked down.
keywords.Solace: Discard a Mind Condition card or a Despair token from yourself or an adjacent Titan.
keywords.Spotlight: First ability window: if you have the Priority Target token, gain +1 red Power die for this Attack.
keywords.Stalwart: When about to suffer Knockback, ignore it.
keywords.Suppress (BP/AI): Shuffle the BP (or AI) discard pile into its deck.
keywords.Tumble: When about to suffer Crash, roll a d10; on 6+ ignore it.
keywords.Unique: No more than one instance in play or in the Armory.
keywords.Vault: If adjacent to the Primordial, place yourself on an empty space in a straight line on the opposite side, adjacent to it (either ability window).
keywords.Full Hit / Full Miss: All Attack dice hit / all miss.
keywords.Transform: Flip this card to its other side (active ability, cost as printed). Choose the side at the start of Battle.
keywords.Masterwork: During an Attack Roll, you may re-roll all 1s at no cost.
keywords.Precise: After drawing the BP card, you may target the top card of the BP discard pile instead (shuffle the drawn card back).
keywords.Fire X: 2nd window: place X Fire tokens (turn 1 potential into power each; mandatory; 1 lost at Clear).
keywords.Rouse X: 2nd window: place X Rouse tokens (attacker treats Rage as +1 per token).
keywords.Inspire X: 1st window: up to X knocked down Titans stand up.
keywords.Daze: 1st/2nd window, if adjacent: turn the Primordial so you are in its Rear.
keywords.Armor-piercing: During the Power Roll, ignore Hardened.
keywords.Armor Re-roll X: During an Armor Roll, re-roll up to X Armor dice.
keywords.Roll Out: When about to suffer Knockdown while adjacent to the Primordial, suffer Knockback 4 instead.
keywords.Perishable: Discard this Weapon after resolving an Attack with it.
keywords.Jump: At the start of a movement, ignore one space of a Terrain tile (Advanced: 2 adjacent spaces).
keywords.Midas X: (Cycle IV) Place X Midas tokens on your Gear cards: max 1 per one-hand Weapon, 2 per Armor/Support, 2-3 per multi-hand Weapon (= slots occupied); none on Attachments. A card at its maximum is Aurified: its Ability Box is blank except Possession, Unique, Ranged X-Y, Reach X, Crit Miss and Start of Battle effects. Cannot voluntarily discard a card with Midas tokens. If every card is full, you are Aurified — you die. Midas tokens count as Condition tokens (discarded when you Awaken).
keywords.Midas Immune: Ignore the effects of Midas tokens placed on this particular card.
keywords.Midas Resistant X: You may place X additional Midas tokens on this card before it becomes Aurified.
keywords.Unholy Alchemy: Turn all of your Midas tokens into Ambrosia tokens (not 'gaining Ambrosia' / 'discarding Midas'). Reverse Unholy Alchemy: turn all Ambrosia tokens into Midas tokens.
keywords.Pole Position: If you're adjacent to the Primordial, place your miniature on any other empty space adjacent to the Primordial. Use in either the first or second ability window.
keywords.Hermes Move X: Perform up to X Hermes Moves: move any number of spaces in a straight line, ending on the first Elevated Terrain tile in that line or adjacent to it (empty space; may pass through the Primordial; no Climb test). You may pivot between consecutive moves; only the final space must be empty.
keywords.Hermes Reflex: Resolve one Hermes Move (Advanced: up to 2).
keywords.Hermes Reposition X: During the second ability window, you may resolve X consecutive Hermes Moves.
keywords.Airburst X: Titans in Zone X suffer Knockdown and Knockback 1.
keywords.Auto-inspire: You may stand up as a free action, even when knocked down.
keywords.Closing X: Second ability window: place X Closing tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Attack Roll each token adds +1 Precision to each Attack die and allows a free re-roll of one Attack die.
keywords.Commit (X): To attack with this weapon, pay the cost in parentheses (Midas: gain 1 Midas token; charge: spend 1 Charge; Fire: discard 1 Fire token from the Kratos Pool).
keywords.Double Commit: To attack with this weapon, gain +2 Fate.
keywords.Cryptex Loathing: Treat your Cryptex card as blank.
keywords.Cursed: During your Attack, you cannot re-roll ◆ (Attack dice).
keywords.Defy X: While performing a Skill test caused by a Judgement, treat X successful hits as evaded.
keywords.Float: Gain the Float Condition card, Float (up) side up, and place your miniature on its side.
keywords.Pursuit X: When resolving an AI card, if you're not the Target, move X spaces in a straight line in the same direction as the Primordial.
keywords.Reduction X: You may reduce suffered involuntary movement by up to X (subtypes: Wish Away / Pushback / Knockback / Kickback / Pull Reduction X).
keywords.Restricted (Trait): You can equip only one Gear card with that Trait per Titan.
keywords.Startup X: When you are about to attack, if there are no Kratos tokens in the Kratos Pool, place X Opening and/or Break tokens.
keywords.Strikeback X: If you fully evade a Primordial Attack, you may move up to X spaces and attack, then gain a combat Fatigue token (Interrupt Attack; +1 Power during the Primordial Round).
keywords.Sunstarved: Apply the following ability only while there are no Fire tokens in the Kratos Pool.
keywords.Superior Chance: After you draw a Trauma or Obol card, you may ignore it and draw another from the same deck, removing the You Died Horribly Obol for that draw. Usable even when knocked down.
keywords.Unburden X: Give up to X Condition, Despair or Ambrosia tokens you have to the closest Titan (first or second ability window).
keywords.Wish Away X: The Titan is placed on an Irem Tower in front of the Primordial, at least X spaces away; if none, the Titan dies.
keywords.Wish Armor: When you become the Target of a Wish Attack, you can perform Evasion Rolls and Armor Rolls against it.
keywords.Voluntary Knockdown: You may suffer Knockdown (standing up) as a free action.
keywords.Sun Resistance X: Each Sun Attack hit deals X Danger less to you.
